The '''2021–22 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team''' represented the [[University of Colorado Boulder]] in the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. They were led by head coach [[Tad Boyle]] in his twelfth season at Colorado. The Buffaloes played their home games at [[CU Events Center]] in [[Boulder, Colorado]] as members of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 21–12, 12–8 in [[2021–22 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 Play]] to finish in 4th place. They defeated [[2021–22 Oregon Ducks men's basketball team|Oregon]] in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] before losing in the semifinals to [[2021–22 Arizona Wildcats men's basketball team|Arizona]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 National Invitation Tournament|National Invitation Tournament]], where they lost in the first round to [[2021–22 St. Bonaventure Bonnies men's basketball team|St. Bonaventure]].

==Previous season==
In a season limited due to the ongoing [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]], the [[2020–21 Colorado Buffaloes men's basketball team|Buffaloes]] finished the [[2020–21 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2019–20 season]] 23–9, 14–6 in [[2020–21 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in third place. They advanced to the championship game of the [[2021 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] where they lost to [[2020–21 Oregon State Beavers men's basketball team|Oregon State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2021 NCAA Division I women's basketball tournament|NCAA basketball tournament]] as the No. 5 seed in the East Region, where they defeated [[2020–21 Georgetown Hoyas men's basketball team|Georgetown]] in the first round before losing to [[2020–21 Florida State Seminoles men's basketball team|Florida State]] in the second round.
